name: Altered Snapjaw Shell
summary: At the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases, snapjaws bear altered shells that draw a druid’s attention. Their carapaces may reveal what the fissures beneath the Barrens are doing to local wildlife.

sections.title: Signs of Corruption
sections.body: Oasis snapjaws have changed in ways that trouble those who study the land. The freshwater turtles of Lushwater and Stagnant Oases are believed to drink from springs fed by mysterious underground fissures. Their altered carapaces have caught the attention of researchers at the Crossroads. Tonga Runetotem, a tauren druid, gathers the shells as he seeks to understand the land’s health. He wants to learn whether energies rising from deep below are an unnatural blight or something stranger.

faq.q: What makes these turtle shells altered?
faq.answer: The snapjaws live in springs at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases, fed by deep subterranean fissures. Strange energies rising into the water have changed the creatures that drink there, leaving their carapaces visibly warped.

faq.q: Who wants these shells and why?
faq.answer: Tonga Runetotem, a druid at the Crossroads, asks hunters to gather the shells. He believes changes in native beasts can help reveal what power or corruption is affecting the Barrens’ water supply.
Oasis snapjaws live in the waters and muddy shores of Lushwater Oasis and Stagnant Oasis, south and southeast of the Crossroads.

angles.text: As a druid, you can study the twisted carapaces of oasis beasts to help identify the hidden imbalance disturbing the Barrens’ waters.
